svg.title: Same numbers added, different totals
svg.desc: Computed minus exact running total for three orders of the same 1,536 binary64 values, on one fixed axis from −0.0021 to +0.0021. Given drifts while the large value is held from step 385 to 1,153 and ends −670 × 2⁻²⁰ from exact. Ascending rounds once at step 1,535 and ends +101 × 2⁻²⁰. Descending is exact.
